svg.text: Azure Firewall Monitor - Private Tenant Deployment Topology
1. bicep/setup.bicep deploys SWA Standard (outputLocation: dist/firewall-mon-app), Maps G2, OpenAI gpt-4o, and App Insights.
2. bicep/firewall-mon-azure-stuff.bicep deploys the 1-day/1-partition Event Hub and entity-scoped 'Listen' SAS policy.
Azure Networking Field Architect Handbook | Bicep Deployment (setup.bicep + firewall-mon-azure-stuff.bicep)
